description: This source file implements functions and classes for parsing and handling Wideband Rights Management (WRM) headers, specifically for PlayReady DRM content, including parsing initialization data, extracting key IDs, and creating content header streams.

classes.name: Reader
classes.description: A helper class for reading binary data from a buffer, supporting reading GUIDs, big-endian 32-bit integers, and little-endian 16-bit integers, with methods to skip bytes.

classes.name: WrmHeader
classes.description: A class representing a WRM header, capable of parsing initialization data to extract the header and key ID, and creating content header streams.

methods.name: ParseWrmHeaderFromInitializationData
methods.description: Parses the initialization data to extract the WRM header bytes associated with PlayReady.

methods.name: ParseKeyIdFromWrmHeader
methods.description: Extracts the key ID GUID from the WRM header XML content.

methods.name: CreateWrmHeaderStream
methods.description: Creates an IStream object from the WRM header bytes.

methods.name: CreateContentHeaderFromWrmHeader
methods.description: Creates a content header stream from the WRM header bytes, formatted for PlayReady.

methods.name: ResetStreamPosition
methods.description: Resets the position of an IStream to the beginning.
